items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: We had some fine lady players coming along during that period, like Vi Redd, and Clora(?) Bryant, a trumpet player.

ctx.x: And there was another fine tenor player named Johnny Beradino. He ended up being a card dealer in one of the hotels in Vegas. Hah-hah! But he was a very fine saxophone player. He had a great sound. Fine player.
